newsitem.title: USA: British tourist dies in fall in Calif. park.
newsitem.headline: British tourist dies in fall in Calif. park.

text.p: A 67-year-old British tourist fell to his death while hiking in Yosemite National Park in California, park officials said on Wednesday.
Charles Richards, from Derbyshire in England, fell between 30 and 50 feet (nine and 15 metres) on Sunday, suffering fatal injuries to his head, arms and legs, the national park said.

Richards was cross-country hiking with his wife from the Saddlebag Lake area, just outside the eastern edge of the park, into Yosemite National Park, about 150 miles (240 kms) southeast of San Francisco, it said.

He fell after getting tired and attempting to reach a lower elevation, it said. Richards' wife spent the night in the backcountry and reported the accident after hiking out on on Monday, the park said. Park rescuers recovered the body on Tuesday.
It was the seventh accidental death in Yosemite National Park this year.
Yosemite, a huge, scenic park in the Sierra Nevada mountains, receives more than 4 million visitors a year.
